CustomField.description: This field is for cumulative reporting purposes in which the Policy Exceptions 1-3 will be summarized in one field for the B of I report that they request.
CustomField.formula: IF(TEXT(Policy_Exception_3__c) <> '', TEXT(Policy_Exception_1__c) + ',' + ' ' + TEXT(Policy_Exception_2__c) + ',' + ' ' + TEXT(Policy_Exception_3__c), IF(TEXT(Policy_Exception_2__c) <> '',TEXT(Policy_Exception_1__c) + ',' + ' ' + TEXT(Policy_Exception_2__c), TEXT(Policy_Exception_1__c)))
